trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast, textured clusters of barnacle colonies located at the furthest lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan biological film (diatom accumulation) visible over approximately 50% of the high-intensity ventral surface.
